From sketch to SVG

1. Upload a photo or scan, or use your phone’s photo picker.

2. Adjust threshold to capture your lines. Smooth edges and remove stray speckles.

3. Pick your ink color and download your SVG.

Best for single-color drawings, lettering, and silhouettes. Exported SVGs contain editable vector paths with no embedded image. Images are processed locally at up to 900 pixels on the longest side.
